description: Source code for managing Wi-Fi access point neighbors, including functions for finding, adding, updating, deleting neighbor entries, and handling related object lifecycle events in a network management context.

classes.name: T_ApNeighbour
classes.description: Structure representing a neighboring access point with properties such as BSSID, SSID, operating class, channel, phy type, and other neighbor-specific info.

classes.name: T_AccessPoint
classes.description: Structure representing an access point, including a list of neighbors and relevant information such as alias and associated objects.

methods.name: void debugPrintNeighbour(T_ApNeighbour * neigh)
methods.description: Prints neighbor details for debugging purposes.

methods.description: Finds a neighbor object in a given template object matching the provided BSSID string.

methods.name: void s_removeNeighbor(T_AccessPoint * pAP,T_ApNeighbour * neigh)
methods.description: Removes a neighbor from the access point, triggers callback for neighbor deletion, and logs the change.
